description: Set lead-engagement config: source accounts, likes per lead, leads scanned per source, skip filters. Partial — only fields you pass change. Editing interrupts a run in progress. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

bannedWords.description: Space-separated words; skip leads whose posts contain them.

custom.description: Take leads from the given `sources` (true) or from accounts you follow (false).

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

sources.description: Space-separated @usernames to pull leads from; used when custom=true.
